name: max_worker_processes
description: Maximum number of concurrent background worker processes that the PostgreSQL instance can support, including logical replication workers, parallel query workers, and custom background workers.
symptoms: Inability to scale parallel scans or joins
tuning_tips: Set to at least the number of CPU cores; match or exceed the master's value on standby servers. Increase only if deploying many parallel queries, logical replication, or custom background workers. On an 8-core machine, values beyond 64 provide no benefit and may cause PG startup failures.
